component.name: Decksynth
component.summary: Touch-friendly synth, sampler, sequencer and drum machine

description.p: Decksynth is a Steam Deck-focused music workstation with a synthesizer, sampler, MIDI sequencer, drum rack and a song workflow for four to eight tracks.
Includes five generated Luna demo kits with sixteen ready-to-play pads each.
Plugins (Beta): host a VST3 plugin (Linux, or Windows through yabridge) in a helper of its own, play it live from MIDI, and record it into a Sampler. This part is a public beta and will change.
Sends: a shared reverb and delay every track can feed.
